lead_independence.headline: Florida Senate President Albritton Now Opposes Amendment 3
lead_independence.lead: Florida Senate President Ben Albritton says he will vote against Amendment 3 in November, months after the State Senate voted to place the measure on the ballot. Amendment 3 would raise the homestead exemption for Florida homeowners to $150,000 in 2027 and $250,000 in 2028, and would cut property taxes for homesteaded homeowners, excluding school taxes. The measure needs 60% voter approval on Election Day to become law.

source_focus.source_title: Florida voters weigh 3 amendments impacting homestead taxes, budget stabilization, agricultural industry
source_focus.source_lead: Florida voters will decide three statewide amendments when they head to the polls on Tuesday, with a property tax proposal drawing the most attention.Amendment 1 would boost Florida's budget stabilization fund from 10% to 25% and require annual transfers into the fund of up to $750 million. Lawmakers would be allowed to use those reserves for certain critical state needs.

rejected.headline: Martin County judge imposes effective life sentence in AI child exploitation case

lead_independence.headline: Martin County judge imposes effective life sentence in AI child exploitation case
lead_independence.lead: Martin County Judge Elizabeth Metzger imposed a prison sentence effectively equal to life on Daniel Warren for using artificial intelligence to create child sexual abuse material. Warren used covert photos of neighborhood children to generate sexualized images that he shared with others, prosecutor Kristen Chase said.
